timer_plan.name: CommonPhaseAge
timer_plan.type: logical tick counter, not a wall-clock timer
reset_conditions: entry into RED from reset or AMBER
timer_plan.implementation_note: A single USINT age counter may implement all dwells; the active threshold is selected by phase.

safety: Enable = FALSE has highest priority and immediately forces RED with phase := 0 and age := 0.
Lamp outputs must remain one-hot and must match Phase: Red <-> Phase=0, Green <-> Phase=1, Amber <-> Phase=2.
Phase must remain in the valid range 0..2.
No phase skipping is permitted; RED requires 2 ticks, GREEN requires 3 ticks, AMBER requires 1 tick.
All outputs are assigned once, after state transition processing.
operational: Tick is a logical scan-count pulse, not wall-clock time.
When Enable is TRUE and Tick is FALSE, phase and age are unchanged.
When Enable is TRUE and Tick is TRUE, age increments once per scan.
A phase advance occurs only when the post-increment age reaches the current phase threshold; age resets to 0 on advance.
Outputs reflect the post-transition phase in the same scan.

initial_values.Enable: sampled input; not forced by controller
initial_values.Tick: sampled input; not forced by controller

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Sample Enable and Tick once at the start of the scan.
Do not re-read Enable or Tick later in the scan.
Tick is treated as a logical invocation count: each scan with sampled Tick = TRUE counts as one tick when Enable = TRUE.
No separate physical edge detection or wall-clock timing is required.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: First apply highest-priority safety reset: if !Enable, force state RED, phase := 0, age := 0, and skip Tick processing.
Else execute exactly one transition using the sampled Tick and current retained state.
If Enable & !Tick, hold phase and age.
If Enable & Tick, compute age + 1; if the new age reaches the active threshold, advance phase := (phase + 1) mod 3 and set age := 0; otherwise retain phase and assign age := age + 1.
Updated state becomes the retained state for the next scan q[k+1].

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: No IEC TON/TOF/TP timer FBs are required because all durations are logical tick counts.
If timer FBs are present for other purposes, call them unconditionally at top level outside CASE/IF; never place FB calls inside conditional state branches.
For this design, stage 3 contains no conditional timer FB calls.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
actions: Assign outputs exactly once after all transition processing.
